# name: Vucub Caquix loses his teeth and dies; Zipacna and the four hundred boys
# title: Cate cut ta xebec ꜩamal
# fols: fols. 7v–9r
Cate cut ta xebec ꜩamal cubi ri Vucub Caquix chuvach vcalibal; ta xe icouic ri atit, mama, que eꜩeyah cu ri e caib ꜭaholab chiquih; ta xe icou chuxe rochoch ahau, cu racuh cu vchi ri Vucub Caquix rumal re.

Ta xil cut Vucub Caquix ri mama, atit, cachbilan quib. “Apa quix pe vi, ca mam?” xꜭha cu ri ahau. “Xa oh ꜩucubei quib, lal ahau,” xeꜭha cut.

“Naquipa iꜩucubal? Ma ivalcual ri ivachbilan?” “Mahabi, lal ahau; e ca mam ri; xere nare ca ca tocobah qui vach, ri yaaxel hupir chacap ca caya chiquech, lal ahau,” xeꜭha cut ri atit, mama.

Cuꜩin cu ri ahau rumal vcoxom ve; xa cu nimac vachih chic ca ꜭhauic: “In ta ba canih chivech; chi tocobah ta nu vach. Naquipa qui chi bano, naquion qui chi cunah?” xꜭha cut ahau.

“Xa vchicopil eiah chi quelezah, xa cu vbac vvach chi ca cunah, xa bac chi ca vico, lal ahau,” xeꜭha cut.

“Vꜩ bala. Chi cunah ta ba ve quiꜩih ca coxouic hutaꜫih; maui choꜫitahic, mahabi nu varam rumal, ruꜭ vbac nu vach. Xa xi quivbah e caib ꜭaxtoꜭ ta xticaric; maui quin echahic rumal. Quehe ta cut chi tocobah vi nu vach; xa ca chuiub vehe chic ri ve.”

“Vꜩ bala, lal ahau. Chicop ba ca cuxuuic; xa choc vꜫexel, chel ri e la.” “Maba vꜩ lo chel ri ve? Rumal xere in ahau vi, nu caubal ri ve, ruꜭ vbac nu vach.” “Xchi ca coh chic na cut vꜫexel, hocom bac; xchoc chic.” Are cut hocom bac ri xa zaqui ixim. “Vꜩ bala; chivelezah, chi too vloc,” xꜭha cut.

Ta xel cu ri re Vucub Caquix; xa zaqui ixim vꜫexel re xoquic, xa chi cu zac huluhuh chi vla ixim pu chi.

Huzucu xcah vvach, maui ahau chic xvachinic. Xquiz elic ri re, caual, raxcanacoh pu chi. Ta xcunax chi cut vbac vvach Vucub Caquix; ta xcholic vbac vvach, xquiz elic ri puvac.

Mana ca xtah xunao; xaui xere ca mucunic, ta xquiz cu elic ri vnimarizabal rib, xaui qui naoh ri Hunahpu, Xbalanque.

Ta xcam cut ri Vucub Caquix, ta xucam cut vꜫab ri Hunahpu. Xcam nai puch Chimalmat, rixoquil Vucub Caquix.

Quehe cut vzachic vꜫinomal Vucub Caquix; ri xa ahꜭun xcamouic ri caual, yamanic, xupunabeh varal chuvach vleu.

Naual atit, naual mama xbanouic. Ta xquicam cut qui ꜫab, xtiquitax vcoc, vꜩ chic xuxic.

Xa rumal vcamic Vucub Caquix xcah quehe xquibano; iꜩel xquilo nimarizabal ib. Cate cut xebec chic e caib ꜭaholab; xa vꜩih ri Vꜭux Cah ta xquibano.

Vae chi cute vbanoh chic Zipacna, vnabe ꜭahol Vucub Caquix. “In banol huyub,” caꜭha ri Zipacna.

Are cu ri Zipacna catinic chu chi ha, ta xe icouic omuch ꜭaholab, e hur vi che racan qui cabal; omuch chubinic, ta xquicat cut hun nima che, vvapalil qui cabal.

Cate cut xbe ri Zipacna, xopon cu chila cuꜭ ri omuch ꜭaholab. “Naquipa qui bano, ix ꜭaholab?” “Xa che maui ca ca yaco chi teleba.” “Xchin teleh. Apa copon vi? Naquipa vchac chi iꜭux?” “Xa vvapalil ca cabal.” “Vꜩ bala,” cha cut. Ta xuhuruh cut, xuteleba ca acanoc chu chi qui cabal omuch ꜭaholab.

“Xa ta vi cat ꜭohe cuꜭ, at ꜭahol. Ꜭo pa a chuch, a cahau?” “Mahabi,” xꜭha cut. “Ca ca chaquimah tana bala chuvec chu vabaxic chic hun ca che racan ca cabal.” “Vꜩ,” xꜭha chi cut.

Cate cut xcam qui naoh ri omuch ꜭaholab: “Are ri ala, hupacha chi ca ban chire chi ca camizah tah? Rumal maui vꜩ ri cu bano; xa vtuquel mi xuyac ri che. Ca coto hun nima hul; chiri ta cut chi ca ꜩac vi cahoc pa hul. Ha cama caha vleu pa hul, coh ꜭha ta chire. Chi are ta cut pachal cahoc pa hul, ta ca tarih cahoc ri nima che; chiri ta cut chi cam vi pa hul,” xeꜭha cut omuch ꜭaholab.

Ta xquicot cut hun nima hul, naht xcahic. Ta xquitac cut ri Zipacna: “Oh canih chavech; chi be ta a coto chic vleuh, maui ca ca rico,” xuchaxic.

“Vꜩ bala,” xꜭha cut. Cate cut xcah pa hul. “Ca ziquin vloc ta coto tahoc ri vleu; naht ta chi cahic avmal?” xuꜭhaxic. “Ve,” xꜭha cut, ta xutiquiba vcotic hul; xa cu vhul xucoto vcolbal rib. Xretamah ri vcamizaxic; ta xucot cut hun vi chi hul chu ꜩalanem; vca hul xuticoto, xcolotah vi.

“Ca hanican pala?” xuꜭhax cu cahoc cumal omuch ꜭaholab. “Qui na nu coto; ve xquix nu ziquih acanoc, ta chuꜩinoc vcotobahic,” xcha vloc Zipacna chiri pa hul.
